dedupe_keys.name: pore pressure and accelerometer raw data from site c experiment

description: TU Delft provides raw pore-pressure and accelerometer observations from an induced submerged slope failure at Site-C. A suction dredger undercut the slope toe during flowslide monitoring. The source links these sensors to Chapter 6.2.3 and the experiment to Chapter 6.5 of the associated sand-slope thesis. Coverage: The test-site location is unstated.; 21/08/2019. Format: dat. Access: public native descriptive metadata. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The DAT descriptor does not specify encoding, variables, units, sampling interval or sensor calibration. The source-defined parent collection concerns breaching flowslides during mining activities. Simulation use is interpreted as mining slope-hazard and geotechnical calibration evidence; no independent model validation is asserted. Related resources in the native collection have separate identities.
